drivers.why_material: Catalyst trial NCT04227106 timeline masking: claimed 'on track' for late-3Q/early-4Q 2022 readout while registry showed repeated slippage (2020-09 → 2022-03 → 2022-09) as of April 2022 update, concealing drift pattern.
Catalyst trial NCT04227106 timeline masking: asserted 'on track' for Q3/Q4 2022 while omitting the three successive registry slippages documented in CT.gov history.
Catalyst trial NCT04227106 timeline masking: March 2022 claim of Q3 2022 readout contradicted the then-current registry completion date of 2022-03 (Q1), misrepresenting expected timing.

Catalyst trial NCT04227106 timeline masking: expressed 'increased confidence' in Q3 2022 timing despite registry showing 2022-03 completion and prior slippage, artificially inflating execution certainty.

analyst_note: Abeona repeatedly guided to on-track Q3 2022 topline readout for the Phase 3 VIITAL trial (EB-101, RDEB) throughout 2021–2022, while ClinicalTrials.gov registration history documented three successive primary completion date slips (September 2020 → March 2022 → September 2022). Multiple press releases claimed the program was 'on track' or expressed 'increased confidence' without disclosing the pattern of drift, and one claim cited Q3 timing when the registry showed Q1. This is a consistent pattern of timeline masking specific to the catalyst trial. All findings are minor severity and operational rather than data-integrity issues, so the call is ELEVATED rather than EXCLUDE—investors should recognize execution-credibility risk but no direct evidence of clinical data manipulation.
